spatial.weights: row-standardized directed great-circle k nearest neighbors, same full 1102-entity universe as original
spatial.local_test: same conditional two-sided permutation and period-wise BH as original
spatial.jaccard: HH overlap / union relative to k=8; missing if both sets empty
spatial.limits: k sensitivity only; not contiguity or small-area smoothing; finite Monte Carlo p-values; no test of differences in I

seasonal.window: circular average of available weeks; national missing week never filled as zero
seasonal.flat_curves: phase missing if no positive amplitude
seasonal.circular_linear: multiple-correlation magnitude of latitude with sin/cos(2*pi*(week-1)/52); no north/south sign
seasonal.limits: sensitivity of observed maxima, not sampling confidence intervals, no complete bimodality analysis or causal mechanism
